sys_script_include.description: Returns the specified url parameter as a string value and validates the value using the given function. If no function is provided, the function IsSecureParameterValue() is used by default. In client-callable Script Includes under some (random) circumstances, the object returned by gs.action.getGlideURI() does not yield the parameters - hence the AjaxAbstractProcessor::getParameter() function must be used as a fallback - and this requires the class object (this) to be provided into the GetParam function as a parameter - as JavaScript does not provide a way to access the calling object from within a function.
sys_script_include.name: GetParam
